name: PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector + pg_textsearch
description: One PostgreSQL 17 server per app with production, preview and test databases, each with its own role. pgvector and pg_textsearch (BM25) are preloaded.

build.dockerfile:
# Postgres 17 with pgvector (embeddings) and pg_textsearch (BM25 ranking).
FROM pgvector/pgvector:0.8.7-pg17

# The architecture comes from dpkg, not TARGETARCH: the legacy builder leaves TARGETARCH empty.
ARG PG_TEXTSEARCH_VERSION=1.5.1

RUN apt-get update \
  && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl unzip \
  && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/pg-textsearch.zip \
    "https://github.com/timescale/pg_textsearch/releases/download/v${PG_TEXTSEARCH_VERSION}/pg-textsearch-v${PG_TEXTSEARCH_VERSION}-pg17-$(dpkg --print-architecture).zip" \
  && unzip /tmp/pg-textsearch.zip -d /tmp/pg-textsearch \
  && dpkg -i /tmp/pg-textsearch/*.deb \
  && rm -rf /tmp/pg-textsearch /tmp/pg-textsearch.zip /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# pg_textsearch must be loaded when the server starts.
CMD ["postgres", "-c", "shared_preload_libraries=pg_textsearch"]

guide.useHint: Use the production, preview or test URL in the matching project environment.

fields.label: Database base name
fields.patternError: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore (max 55).
fields.help: Creates <name>_prod, <name>_preview and <name>_test, for example myapp_prod. Used only on the first start.
